shortDescription: Find space across your transporter network. A clearer start for your next load.
fullDescription:
Know who has space before you call.

When a load comes in, start with the transporters you know. Loadgistic brings their reported truck space, routes and approximate locations together on one map, so you can find a useful starting point and speak to the right person.

THE TRUCKS YOU KNOW
Keep the transporters you work with close. Ask them to share with your email, verify that email, and open your private capacity map. See the trucks shared with you together; your private contacts and signals stay out of other visitors’ views.

LET THE RIGHT PEOPLE SEE YOUR SPACE
Transporters can share available room and service routes with regular contacts, open them to the public, do both, or choose one recipient. Update your space and approximate location as work changes. Independent drivers manage one current truck; transport companies manage their trucks and drivers.

MORE OPTIONS FOR THE NEXT LOAD
If you need another truck, explore public capacity without an account. Search transporter profiles and filter by route, truck configuration and the space your load needs. Check how recently the signal was updated, then confirm availability and agree on the work directly.

KEEP EVERYONE IN THE PICTURE
After transport is agreed, give authorized shipment partners private progress updates, approximate location and loading and unloading photos. The shipment owner approves unloading from their private tracking page.

A HAND WITH THE HARD PART
Need help arranging transport? Tell Loadgistic’s transport team about your load and continue the conversation in live chat.

Built around East African road freight. Use English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Somali or Tigrinya.

Location sharing needs your consent and Android permissions. Agreed active tracking can continue in the background until unloading is approved. Shared locations are approximate. Notifications are optional.

Document badges identify the specific documents Loadgistic reviewed, not a service guarantee. Loadgistic does not handle in-app transport payments.
